name: 结构与假设发现时序工作流
purpose: 完成Step 2后调用结构与假设发现算子，再根据专家提供的现实边界完成Step 3及后续建模。

actions.rule: Complete Steps 1 and 2 and record the problem understanding and modeling assumptions.
Select the highest-priority unresolved structural assumption and apply the referenced operator.
Incorporate relevant advice into the model, validate affected results, and complete Steps 3 through 7.

stop_condition: Stop after completing the model and validating the consultation's downstream effects.

name: 实现模型解释一致性时序工作流
purpose: 完成可执行模型后调用实现模型解释一致性算子，消解现实解释、公式、结果和报告之间的冲突。

actions.rule: Complete Steps 1 through 5 and audit the provisional model and outputs for high-risk inconsistencies.
Select the highest-priority interpretation-dependent inconsistency and apply the referenced operator.
Apply relevant advice, regenerate dependent outputs, run the existing regression checks, and complete Steps 6 and 7.

stop_condition: Stop after testing the focal conflict and reconciling its dependent outputs.

name: 验证失败信号证伪时序工作流
purpose: 初步验证后调用验证失败信号算子，针对残留差异、边界情景和外部比较目标执行独立证伪。

actions.rule: Complete Steps 1 through 5 and use existing outputs plus one lightweight preliminary check to identify the single residual gap most likely to change the main decision.
Select the highest-priority residual validation gap and apply the referenced operator.

Test the focal signal with at most one bounded analytic check or small scenario comparison, revise only the affected claim, and complete Steps 6 and 7 without interaction-driven broad search, nested optimization, Monte Carlo, or multi-parameter sweeps.

stop_condition: Stop after one bounded test of the focal gap and one localized claim revision.
